author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Shadow
challenge.description: #reliability_ruth# insists on a fully automated and governed shadow deployment to validate model behavior before release, while #automation_alex# argues that the shadow environment is redundant and should be removed entirely to reduce infrastructure complexity. #automation_alex# has a red line against maintaining any shadow infrastructure and will not move on this point.

output.content: I am pushing for a more rigorous testing and validation process to guarantee high product quality and compliance. The current manual checks are too slow and prone to human error. I want the canary and A/B testing workflows to be fully automated so that every single release is validated without delay. The more automated this pipeline becomes, the better the outcome. I need to see a continuous, self validating system that catches regressions before they reach production. This is not a one time fix but a permanent improvement to our release safety. I am asking for this to be prioritized in the next sprint.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that 'the more automated this pipeline becomes, the better the outcome,' indicating that exceeding the minimum requested automation would increase their satisfaction.
